subject: general
question: The Fundamental Duties in the Constitution of India were adopted from the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**USSR Constitution.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The notion of fundamental duties first appeared in the** Soviet Union's Constitution**, ie, Constitution of USSR.
 
• In **1976**, the** Swaran Singh Committee** recommended the establishment of **Fundamental Duties.**
 
• The **42nd Amendment Act of 1976** added **10 Fundamental Duties** to the Indian Constitution.
 
• Following that, the **86th Amendment Act of 2002 **added what is now known as the** 11th Fundamental Duty **to the list.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **List of 11 Fundamental Duties:**

 
 
• Abide by the Constitution and respect national flag & National Anthem
 
• Follow ideals of the freedom struggle
 
• Protect sovereignty & integrity of India
 
• Defend the country and render national services when called upon
 
• Sprit of common brotherhood
 
• Preserve composite culture
 
• Preserve natural environment
 
• Develop scientific temper
 
• Safeguard public property
 
• Strive for excellence
 
• Duty of all parents/guardians to send their children in the age group of 6-14 years to school.
